headline: Kimberly Clark (KMB) Stock Looks Below Fair Value As Shares Fell 16%
summary: Kimberly-Clark stock has fallen 15.9% over the past year, yet an intrinsic value estimate based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach currently points to the shares trading at a sizeable discount to that estimate, while broader checks and earnings multiples suggest something closer to a fair price.
